item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Require acknowledgment before completing a key handoff","mechanism":"Separate proposed transfers from confirmed receipt, retaining the last confirmed holder while explicitly showing uncertainty.","implementation":"Give only the two volunteers access. Sender selects “Offer key”; recipient selects “Received” and records handoff time. Allow one pending transfer.","check":"Offer without acknowledgment: the display must show the last confirmed holder and unresolved transfer. Acknowledge: holder and handoff time must update.","risk":"An unrecorded physical transfer can still make the display stale."},{"action":"Replace chat searching with one pinned key record","mechanism":"An append-only handoff history supplies a single current summary without silently erasing disputed or corrected entries.","implementation":"Pin a shared record showing last confirmed holder, handoff time, and unresolved transfers. Record corrections as linked entries; regenerate the summary.","check":"Enter two completed transfers, then correct one timestamp. Verify the current holder remains correct and both timestamp versions remain inspectable.","risk":"Maintaining a separate chat-based record would recreate conflicting sources."},{"action":"Escalate overdue handoffs into explicit reconciliation","mechanism":"A deadline surfaces missing acknowledgment without automatically treating silence as receipt or cancellation.","implementation":"Have the volunteers choose an acknowledgment window. Flag overdue transfers and notify both. Resolve through timestamped receipt, sender-confirmed non-transfer, or an explicit dispute.","check":"Let an offer expire. Verify it remains unresolved, both volunteers are notified, and no holder change occurs solely from elapsed time.","risk":"Reminders cannot establish physical possession when volunteers disagree."}],"abstention_reason":""}
